title: JBCクラシックの後に・浮かれ気分で？

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The JBC Classic turns out to be a huge hit, thanks in no small part to Smart Falcon's popularity.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our next goal is the pinnacle of dirt racing, the year-end Tokyo Daishoten.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, a conversation with fans reaffirms that the public's attention come year's end is instead centered on the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, we decide to go watch the Arima Kinen in preparation for the Tokyo Daishoten.
